gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-mada: Eight Bit Dragon strides along with widely separated letters and tall lowercase, a display face with real nerve. Mada follows with open curves that refuse to close, so a long passage moves along easily beneath it.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-martel-sa: Adventurous and bold, Eight Bit Dragon lets its horizontals run a notch lighter than its uprights. Martel Sans sits beneath with generous openings in each curve, so a long passage keeps moving without a snag.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-matangi: Bold and adventurous, Eight Bit Dragon keeps its stroke contrast tempered, never jolting and never flat. Matangi is a monoline sans of rounded, open letters, and Eight Bit Dragon earns its keep big and brief above it.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro reads as a plain sans with a welcoming gap in the c and a high-waisted lowercase. Meanwhile Eight Bit Dragon eases only slightly in weight at its joins, so a long passage feels smooth and unforced.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-michroma: Michroma reads wide and spaced out, each letter given a generous berth, with tall lowercase and stubby ascender tips. Michroma also looks best with a little size to it, while Eight Bit Dragon keeps its stem and joining strokes restrained.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-miriam-li: Tall, wiry and lively. Eight Bit Dragon pinches slightly where curves meet stems, and Miriam Libre brings the glow of neon tubing with a lowercase that stands like cast iron capitals.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-mochiy-po: Eight Bit Dragon's most telling trait is its relaxed stride over widely separated letters, with a middling spread between heavy and light parts. Mochiy Pop P One draws a single flat line weight through every glyph, so it carries the text while the dragon carries the attitude.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-montserra: Wide-striding and tall, with a mid-range gap between its boldest and faintest strokes. Montserrat Underline answers with pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, and Eight Bit Dragon earns its keep large and short.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-mozilla-h: Eight Bit Dragon pairs sturdy hairlines with moderate stems, spaced in a relaxed stride. Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, and the two stand together without crowding each other.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-mozilla-t: Mozilla Text reads as a plain sans whose tall lowercase looks bold and whose terminals flare outward. Eight Bit Dragon adds a faint taffy-like swell in each curve above it, giving the page a lively top and a steady base.
